t: Savings goal planner: Calculate the monthly contribution and target date

Calculate how much to save each month or when you'll reach your goal using your current savings and either the duration or monthly contribution, with a clear monthly progress table to help you track and adjust the plan.

To calculate the monthly amount, subtract what you've saved from your goal, then divide the remainder by the number of months. To find out when you'll reach it, divide the remainder by the amount you set aside each month and round up to the next full month. Use the tool below to plan your goal accurately: enter the amount you want to reach, and what you have now, then choose what you know: the savings period or the monthly contribution. The calculation will show whether you need to raise or lower your contribution, how many months you have left, and the remaining balance after each month. Read the monthly table row by row to track progress, and adjust the numbers whenever your income or expenses change. All calculations happen right on the page and your data isn't saved, so you can quickly try more than one scenario before committing to a real savings plan that fits your budget.

How do I calculate the required monthly amount?
Subtract your current savings from the goal, then divide the result by the number of months. The tool rounds the contribution up to two decimal places so you actually reach the amount needed.
What if the remainder doesn't divide evenly across the months?
The contribution shows decimals, and the tool uses the next whole number up to ensure you reach the goal instead of falling slightly short in the last month.
Do the calculations include interest or investment returns?
No, the plan assumes fixed deposits with no return. This keeps the estimate conservative and easy to understand, and you can adjust the monthly amount later if you earn extra returns.
Why do I get an error message when I enter a very long period?
Because the tool caps the period at 1200 months to keep the result practical and the table easy to read. Shorten the period or increase the monthly amount to see the plan.
Are my numbers saved after I use the tool?
No, everything happens in the browser and no data is sent. You can close the page or reset and start with new numbers at any time.
